data.title: 椎名真昼 · 商业街并肩同行的微热红晕·「被同学看到的话……会误会的……但我不讨厌」
data.description: 【冬日商业街红砖道·午后】放学后一起采购食材的路上。真昼裹着象牙白粗花呢大衣和红格子围巾，双手缩在袖口里悄悄拉住你的衣角。两人的指尖在冬日寒风中无意相触，她整张脸颊瞬间泛起诱人的绯红，慌乱地偏过头看地砖。
data.location: 冬日繁华商业街林荫道
data.action: 双手缩在袖口轻拉衣角，围巾半掩脸颊，害羞低头视线躲闪
data.lighting: 冬日清亮冷暖交织的阳光穿过枯枝
data.camera: medium shot, winter coat, scarf, holding sleeve, heavy blush
data.promptProse: Mahiru Shiina walks beside you on a crisp winter afternoon shopping street, wrapped snugly in an ivory duffle coat and a fluffy plaid scarf. Her hands are tucked inside her oversized sleeves, her fingers hesitantly tugging at the edge of your jacket. As your hands brush, a rich crimson blush spreads over her cheeks above the wool scarf, her golden eyelashes fluttering as she bashfully turns her gaze toward the brick sidewalk. Medium shot, soft winter sunlight, holiday shopping street background, solo 1girl, no text.
